category_description: Federal income tax, payroll tax and other taxes in the United States.

label: Basic estate tax exclusion amount
context: For estates of decedents who die during the year. The amount an estate can pass on before federal estate tax applies.

label: Annual gift tax exclusion per recipient
context: The first amount of gifts to any person in a calendar year that is not counted in the total taxable gifts for the year.

label: Annual gift exclusion to a spouse who is not a US citizen
context: The annual exclusion for gifts to a spouse who is not a citizen of the United States.
